info.title: FleetLuma API
info.description: FleetLuma v0.1.0 target cloud contract. The pairing/device-management operations are DESIGN ONLY until runtime implementation and tests are merged. Existing cloud monitoring routes are live and require approved Supabase JWTs; agent reports use separate per-host credentials. For multi-workspace listing, workspace_id query is mandatory in the target contract; today's deployed API is not yet compatible.

servers.description: Existing verified cloud API preview; not a stable production domain; new pairing endpoints are not deployed

post.description: Authorization: Bearer token. Server resolves host identity strictly from the token, not a client-supplied host_id. Only a fully validated and transactionally committed report updates last_seen_at. captured_at sampled_at is the agent clock; received_at is coordinator UTC time. Duplicate reports are allowed as separate samples in MVP; retries may yield duplicates. No remote commands. v0.1.0 target also requires ACTIVE host lifecycle and workspace binding; revoked token must return 401 without DB mutation.

get.summary: List fleet with latest metrics and heartbeat status
get.description: In cloud mode an approved operator JWT and workspace-scoped authorization are required. Design target; existing runtime currently enforces global approved-operator allowlist.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Approved workspace to scope the fleet listing (v0.1 target, not supported by current runtime).

At most 24h. Use sampled_at for measurements, received_at for freshness; output is ordered ascending. In cloud mode an approved operator JWT and workspace-scoped authorization are required. Design target; existing runtime currently enforces global approved-operator allowlist.

An absent snapshot returns captured_at null with an empty array. CPU percent may exceed 100 on multi-core systems. In cloud mode an approved operator JWT and workspace-scoped authorization are required. Design target; existing runtime currently enforces global approved-operator allowlist.

Service configuration is done out-of-band. A service can have no host_id, and service health is not derived from agent heartbeat.
